Enum Class CanvasColor

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<CanvasColor>
ua.stetsenkoinna.theme.CanvasColor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<CanvasColor>, Constable
public enum CanvasColor extends Enum<CanvasColor>
The roles a colour can play in the net drawing. Each theme supplies one colour per role, and CanvasPalette refuses to be built without all of them - so adding a role here is a compile-and-run reminder to decide what it looks like in both themes, rather than a value that silently stays null in whichever one was forgotten.

    • ELEMENT_FILL

      public static final CanvasColor ELEMENT_FILL
      Inside a place or a transition. Equal to CANVAS_BACKGROUND in both themes: a shape is defined by its outline, and its fill exists only to hide what passes underneath. Kept as its own role so that stops being an accident if it ever needs to stop being true.

    • LINKED_PLACE_FILL

      public static final CanvasColor LINKED_PLACE_FILL
      The inside of a place that is linked to another one, rather than the plain element fill.

      Replaces the ring colour that used to mark a shared place, now that a link is always drawn as a line: the ring is gone, so a place carried nothing on it saying its marking is not its own. Filling it says that wherever it is drawn, including on a canvas where the other end is not visible at all.

    • FUSION_RING_SELECTED

    • CONNECTOR_STRAND

      public static final CanvasColor CONNECTOR_STRAND
      The other strands of the connector whose strand the user picked.

      Distinct from FUSION_RING_SELECTED on purpose: the whole connector has to be visible, but the link actually clicked is still the one being pointed at, and drawing both in one colour claims they are equally what was picked.
